gloss: view of life; philosophy of life

definitions.gloss: view of life; philosophy of life; outlook on life
definitions.explanation: One's fundamental beliefs and attitudes about life, its meaning, and how it should be lived. A person's overall perspective on what matters in life.

examples.japanese: {人生観|じんせいかん}が{変|か}わった。
{旅|たび}は{人生観|じんせいかん}を{広|ひろ}げてくれる。
examples.english: Travel broadens your outlook on life.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きな{病気|びょうき}を{経験|けいけん}して、{彼|かれ}の{人生観|じんせいかん}は{大|おお}きく{変|か}わったという。
examples.english: They say his outlook on life changed greatly after experiencing a serious illness.

notes:
A compound of {人生|じんせい} (life, human life) + {観|かん} (view, outlook). The suffix ～{観|かん} is productive and creates many similar compound nouns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人生観|じんせいかん}が{変|か}わる: one's outlook on life changes
- {人生観|じんせいかん}を{持|も}つ: to have an outlook on life
- {人生観|じんせいかん}に{影響|えいきょう}する: to influence one's view of life

RELATED ～{観|かん} COMPOUNDS:
- {世界観|せかいかん}: worldview
- {価値観|かちかん}: values, sense of values
- {死生観|しせいかん}: view of life and death
- {恋愛観|れんあいかん}: view of romance/love
- {仕事観|しごとかん}: view of work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {価値観|かちかん}: values — what one considers important, not necessarily about life as a whole
- {世界観|せかいかん}: worldview — broader, encompassing how one sees the world and reality
- {人生観|じんせいかん}: specifically about one's philosophy of how to live
